name: deepseek-desktop
description: Standalone community distribution of DeepSeek Desktop

scripts.runtime:update:package: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/runtime-sync.mjs && node runtime/scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/runtime-update/package-runtime.mjs
scripts.rust:test: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/with-rust.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.rust:check: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/with-rust.mjs cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.rust:clippy: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/with-rust.mjs rustup component add clippy && node scripts/with-rust.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/runtime-sync.mjs && node runtime/scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/with-rust.mjs tauri dev --config target/generated/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/app-sync.mjs && node scripts/runtime-sync.mjs && node runtime/scripts/stage-runtime.mjs && node scripts/with-rust.mjs tauri build --config target/generated/tauri.conf.json
scripts.verify: node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs app:sync --check && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs test:config && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs check:i18n && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs test && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs typecheck && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:test-locale && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:test-credentials && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:stage && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs runtime:verify && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs rust:test && node scripts/with-pnpm.mjs rust:clippy
